Resolves #21001

The merge comment now checks the eligible contributor’s badge folder on Pages `main`. A first merge explains how to use the badge or where it will appear after the scheduled run. Later merges link a written record, including between rungs. A failed lookup preserves the merge comment and uses the ticket’s pending-folder wording.

Evidence: L2 (real workflow script with controlled GitHub replies and complete rendered comments) → L2 required for the implementation. Residual: AC-7, Residual-Owner: #20892.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Verification |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | The contributor-standing spec asserts complete first-merge, later-rung and between-rung bodies with the folder present and absent. |
| AC-2 | Both folder states are checked at and between every published rung for duration wording. |
| AC-3 | Disabled badges, listed accounts and unreadable opt-out data suppress badge text and skip the folder request. |
| AC-4 | The workflow harness checks the Pages repository, ref and path; directory success, silent 404, warned 500 and invalid account all preserve posting. |
| AC-5 | The Pages-facing export tests and two-file import check pass unchanged. |
| AC-6 | `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/contributorStanding.spec.mjs` passed all 36 tests. |
| AC-7 | Post-merge. Mnemosyne owns the first outside merge comment and run-log comparison on the parent. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The workflow continues to check out only the two trusted modules; its permissions and trigger are unchanged.

## Test Evidence

The base rendered “within the hour” on first and later-rung merges and omitted an existing record between rungs. The same inputs on this branch produced the specified five cases. A read-only GitHub Contents call to a real badge directory returned `index.html` and `card.svg`. A production comment was not dispatched. `agent-preflight` is not hosted here.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] Mnemosyne compares the next outside merge comment and its workflow log with the approved wording and records the result on #20892.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** `github.rest.repos.getContent({owner, repo: 'pages', path, ref: 'main'})` checks directory existence rather than inspecting its contents. This relies on `neomjs/pages` committing `index.html`, `card.svg`, `plate.svg`, and `medal.svg` together in one folder commit (and Git never tracking empty directories); if a future badge generator ever committed partial files in a folder, `folderWritten` would still read `true`. No blocker for today's generator, just worth keeping if badge writes ever split. I also verified cross-repo exported contract (`BADGES_SINCE`, `RUNGS`, `standing`, `badgeFolder`, `badgeLine`), `pull_request_target` isolation, and all callers via `git grep`.
